Transparent header off for /collections/brightening-glow - the FOURTH collection page today to need it. Her lit forehead and cheek sit across the top of this frame, exactly where the navigation renders, and white links vanish into it.

The real fix is to flip the shared default and let pages opt back in; raised repeatedly, not done, because it changes every collection page at once and that is Malcolm's call.

Also note: publish-collection-banner-template.py rebuilds from the shared default on every run, so this has to be re-applied after any republish.
